a correction was selected, submitted and evaluated with the keyboard only (Enter and Space both work)
opening a dialog moves focus into it
Tab stays trapped inside the dialog
Escape closes the dialog and focus returns to the control that opened it
the intro can be skipped with Escape
after the intro, keyboard focus is placed on the main content
on a normal page load the first Tab stop is the 'Skip to content' link
activating the skip link moves focus to the main content
